page.overview:
Who is Ele-fly?

Appearing only in the episode "Whipple the Happy Dragon", the Ele-fly is summoned by a group of Elephants on a volcano.

The Ele-fly is grey. Its eyes are blue and large similar to how flies are animated. Its ears are massive enough to act as wings to lift it off the ground. The Ele-fly has six sets of arms and a trunk.
